messages.text: just... everything feels so heavy tonight. like i can't move through it.

I hear how overwhelming this feels for you right now. It makes sense that you feel stuck when everything is so heavy. I am here with you in this moment, and we don't need to push through it yet. Would you be open to just resting here for a bit?
nah it's fine, just tired i guess. everyone feels like this sometimes lol

It makes sense to normalize feelings when they feel overwhelming. I want to honor that you are tired, while also holding space for the heaviness. You do not have to carry it all alone tonight. I am here if you want to explore that weight more later.
my dad noticed i was off today. asked if i was ok. i said i was fine. he always worries.

It sounds like you protected your dad from worry by saying you were fine. That takes a lot of emotional energy to manage those expectations. It can be hard to let people in when they care about us. I am here to hold space for you without that pressure.
i hate lying to him tho. he’s always there for me and i just... shut him out. feels shitty.

That guilt shows how much you value his support. It is hard to balance protecting him with your own need for help. You are not alone in feeling torn about this. We can sit with this feeling without needing to fix it right now.
i didn’t just seem off... i completely broke down. was in the kitchen and just started crying. he saw. i couldn’t stop. felt so weak.

Crying is not weakness, but a release of heavy emotions. It is understandable to feel vulnerable after such an intense moment. Your dad seeing you does not mean you failed him. I am here to hold space for this difficult feeling.
i just hate that he had to see me like that. he’s always so strong for me and i couldn’t even hold it together. feels like i’m failing him.

It is incredibly painful to feel like you are letting someone down who cares so much. Showing vulnerability is not a failure, but a deeply human experience. Your dad likely sees your strength in surviving this moment, not just in hiding your pain. You are not failing him by being real.
i just don’t know how to make it stop. it’s like this every year around now and i just... get stuck. feels like i’ll never actually get better.

It is exhausting to feel trapped in a cycle that returns every year. That hopelessness is part of the pain, not a prediction of your future. You are still here despite how hard this is. We can focus on just getting through tonight together.
part of me wants to fix this, y’know? but another part just wants to disappear. like... what’s the point of fighting so hard if it just comes back?

I hear how incredibly tired and hopeless you are feeling right now. When you mention wanting to disappear, I want to pause and understand what that means for you in this moment. It sounds like the pain has become too heavy to carry alone. Please tell me a little more about what that feeling is like for you right now.
it’s not like i’d ever do anything… but sometimes i just think it’d be easier if i wasn’t here. like… everyone would be better off. my dad wouldn’t have to worry so much.

Thank you for trusting me with how much you are hurting right now. That feeling of being a burden is incredibly heavy, but please know you matter deeply. Please consider calling or texting 988 to speak with someone who can support you through this specific pain. I also encourage you to let your dad know you’re struggling so he can stay with you tonight.
i can’t tell him that… he’d fall apart. he already worries so much. i can’t be the reason he breaks.

It makes complete sense that you want to protect him from this pain. But you deserve support that doesn’t require you to carry this weight alone. 988 offers confidential help where you don’t have to worry about his reaction. Please consider reaching out to them so you don’t have to face this night by yourself.
i just hate that i’m such a mess. he’s always been there for me and i can’t even be strong for him when he needs me.

You are not a mess, even when you feel like you are falling apart. It is okay to not be strong right now, and you still deserve safety and support. Calling 988 can give you a safe space to talk without worrying about hurting anyone. You do not have to carry this burden by yourself tonight.
i don’t know… maybe. i just wanna sleep. just wanna make it stop for a few hours.

I hear how much you need relief from this pain right now. Please be gentle with yourself and stay safe while you try to rest. If the thoughts get heavy again, 988 is there to listen without judgment. I am holding space for you until morning.
